1946, April 6
The following is a faathful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Fether Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 JEROME STREET BROOKLYN 7, N.Y. April 6th, 1946
Mrs. Helena C. Wilhite Los Angeles, California
My Dear Niece Helena; -
God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your regards in send- ing me the telegram of your dear Edwin's passing - from time to eter- nity, from transitory struggling common to mortals, to the destiny, we trust where anxiety and struggling for existence gives place to confidence and union with every ideal ever dreamed of. If not this directly and fully, at least, please God, shortly to gain the crown and to hear the long hoped for greeting always awaiting the just and humble: "Come ye Blessed blessed of my Father possess to joys pre- pared for you ... "
Now you are not only a orphan but a widow also. What does that mean? For you and for any one who have real faith and Christian hope it ought to mean "Another string broken that tends to bind our hearts to earth." It ought to mean that you you have now another faithful dear one as we confidently hope, a loving husband to pray for you beyond the grave together with your saintly Mother and Father and so many who have loved you and gone ahead. What a won- derful doctrine and consoling to think of our dear ones awaiting us with not only lited candles but greeting us at our arrival with music and hymns of heavenly sweetness .... I've been thinking often of the really touch- family - reunion last summer in Seattle. But what about the great reunion awaiting the arrival of the just in Heaven! ..... I am inclined rather to congratulate you therefore, on another friend praying for you and awaiting your arrival as we hope Ed is ..
Fr. Solanus
Always planing for our very best -- "God condescends to use our powers If we don't spoil His plans by ours."
